usedFor: GAN.AI creates personalized videos, and “Generate Video” makes one in your GAN.AI account from a new contact or form.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Added to List” in ActiveCampaign, then “Generate Video” in GAN.AI
bestTemplate.why: A contact joining a list is a natural moment for a personal video, and the action creates it.

watchOut: Sending the finished video to a contact waits in Needs you until you approve it.
